eligibility: Individual farmers who are owner cultivators
Joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
Farmers engaged in agriculture and allied activities
scheme_details.land_limit: Applicant must possess or cultivate agricultural land. No minimum or maximum land holding specified.

money_benefits.interest_rate: 7% per annum on short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh
money_benefits.maximum_credit_limit: Based on scale of finance, cropping pattern, land holding, and repayment capacity

age_limit.special_condition: Applicants above 60 years may require a legal heir as co-borrower

application_process: Visit the bank website or nearest bank branch.
Bank verifies eligibility and land records.
benefits: Investment credit for agriculture and allied activities
scheme_details.implemented_by: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
